title: Minimum Possible Integer After At Most K Adjacent Swaps On Digits
description: Minimize a number by performing at most k adjacent swaps to place the smallest possible digits at the beginning.
pseudocode:
1. for i from 0 to n-1:
2.   find smallest digit index j in [i, i+k]
3.   shift digit at j to position i by swapping
4.   decrement k by distance moved
5.   if k == 0 break

steps.note: Smallest digit in range [0, 2] is 2 at index 2.
Swap 2 to position 0. Cost is 2 swaps (j-i). Array becomes [2, 4, 3].
